**Finding submitted — deviation (critical), fallback-level cure.**

- **What the document says:** Article XII (p0128–p0129) is a one-way Licensee indemnity covering the exercise of its own licence rights, its business conduct and any breach. No Licensor indemnity exists anywhere (searches for "indemn", "harmless", "defend" surface nothing Licensor-side), and Article XIII (p0130) affirmatively bars Licensor liability for any third-party infringement claim and caps Licensor liability at one half of amounts paid.
- **Classification:** Walk-away territory (no Vendor IP indemnity plus one-way Customer indemnity), so it fails the fallback.
- **Cure (shortest complete fallback package):** new Article XIII-A Licensor IP indemnity with the Licensee modification/combination/specification exclusions, procure–modify–replace–refund remedies and a 3× trailing-12-month fees super-cap, plus two surgical "SUBJECT TO ARTICLE XIII-A" edits so the retained Article XIII infringement exclusion and 0.5× cap do not contradict the new obligation.
- Preferred-only items (defence duty, affiliates, breach-of-law/data-breach/wilful-misconduct prongs, claim procedure, narrowing Licensee's indemnity) were deliberately not added at this level and are noted in the rationale.
